scale: 0.00 to 1.00; higher means higher expected physical traffic to/from this module during normal play
method: Gameplay-informed default traffic weights for the weighted room-pair objective. They are not hidden game constants. The calibration prioritizes repeated physical use by Jan and Alters: mandatory entry/exit and daily routine are highest; staffed workrooms are medium-high; episodic/story and optional wellbeing rooms are lower; passive rooms are zero. Weight 0 excludes a module from objective pairs while it remains subject to all hard placement/connectivity constraints.

airlock.rationale: Primary entry/exit for surface activity; the strongest recurring movement anchor.

workshop.rationale: Repeated crafting of consumables and quest items; Worker commonly spends full work shifts here and Jan can craft manually.

kitchen.rationale: Canteen/food production is part of recurring crew routine; higher traffic than episodic technical/story rooms.

dormitory.rationale: Provides beds for up to four Alters and therefore represents repeated daily sleeping traffic when used.

captains_cabin.rationale: Jan uses the cabin to end the day and sleep, producing a regular once-per-day route.

research_lab.rationale: Scientist-only staffed workroom; when research is queued the Scientist can spend the normal 09:00-21:00 workday here.

social_room.rationale: Recurring crew relaxation plus player-triggered beer pong and movies; group use can generate substantial traffic.

greenhouse.rationale: Staffed production room; Botanist is commonly assigned here for long work shifts when food production is active.

refinery.rationale: Staffed production room; Refiner is commonly assigned here for long work shifts when conversion is active.

command_center.rationale: Required for base building, expansion and journeys, but these interactions are episodic rather than a daily work shift.

machinery.rationale: Recurring radiation-barrier/filter and technical interactions, but much maintenance can be assigned/automated.

communication_room.rationale: Used for Ally Corp/Earth calls tied to story events; important but episodic.

infirmary.rationale: Doctor/patient traffic can be intense during injuries but is otherwise intermittent.

contemplation_room.rationale: Used when Alters need morale/therapy support; situational rather than universal daily traffic.

personal_cabin.rationale: One Alter sleeps here repeatedly, but each cabin serves only one person; multiple cabins contribute separately.

gym.rationale: Optional free-time wellbeing room; Alters cannot be assigned to work here.

gamers_den.rationale: Optional recreation/card-game room comparable to other leisure spaces but not mandatory for routine operations.

park_with_bench.rationale: Optional free-time relaxation module; useful but normally lower traffic than Social Room.

materializer.rationale: Important Act 3 mission module but only episodically interacted with.

quantum_computer.rationale: Critical for Alter creation/lifelines and Qubit progression but physically visited only at discrete story/progression points.

womb.rationale: Essential for Alter creation but normally visited only around creation/story events.

recycler.rationale: Passive Organics generation; no routine physical visit is required.

radiation_repulsor.rationale: Passive utility; no routine visit objective.

small_storage.rationale: Passive storage; inventory does not require physically entering the module.

medium_storage.rationale: Passive storage; inventory does not require physically entering the module.

large_storage.rationale: Passive storage; inventory does not require physically entering the module.

ark_sarcophagus.rationale: Mission storage/terminal module; excluded from routine traffic pairs.

rapidium_ark.rationale: Hermetic Rapidium storage module; excluded from routine traffic pairs.
